summary: November is a quiet, low-price month in Europe and the start of the best season in much of the tropics.
intro: Europe's cities are quiet and cheap before the Christmas markets open late in the month. The days are short in the north, but the northern lights season in the Arctic is getting going.

Across much of South and South-East Asia, Mexico and Central America the dry season begins, bringing some of the best weather of the year. In the southern hemisphere it's late spring, a fine time for Australia and New Zealand before their summer holidays.
